description: Khalid Siraj Textile Mills Limited is a spinner listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, incorporated in 1988, with its registered office at 135-Upper Mall in Lahore and its mill 48 km along the Lahore-Multan Road at Phool Nagar, Kasur. It runs 17,280 spindles producing 100% cotton yarn, with a range covering carded and combed yarns for knitting and weaving, a large share of which is exported to Europe, the Far East and the Middle East. Alongside Pakistani cotton it spins imported US Pima, Egyptian and Australian cotton.
